units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 3:1">Bekh. III, 1</cite> <he>ר׳ בת שתים וכ׳</he> if an ewe gives birth in her second year of age, the issue belongs to the priest with certainty.

<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 10:1">Tosef. Ḥull. X, 1</cite> <he>כלאיים מן הר׳ וכ׳</he> a hybrid of an ewe and a kid is subject to the law concerning the first of the fleece (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 18:4">Deut. XVIII, 4</cite>); a. fr.—Pl. <he>רְחֵלוֹת</he>, <he>רְחֵלִים</he>, <he>רְחֵלִין</he>, <cite ref="T00515"><he>רְחֵי׳</he></cite>. Ib. 4 <he>השוטף רְחֵלָיו</he> if one washes his lambs (and wool comes out).
<cite ref="Deuteronomy 18:4">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 11:2">Ḥull. XI, 2</cite> <he>חמש ר׳ גוזזות וכ׳</he> five lambs yielding wool of the weight of &c.
Ib. 137ᵇ דקא מתני ליה לבריה רחלים taught his son (the Mishnah l. c.) using r’ḥelim (according to Biblical usage); א״ל אתנייה רחלות said he to him, teach him r’ḥeloth (in accordance with later usage).
<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 5:3">Bekh. V, 3</cite> <he>זכר של ר׳</he>, v. <cite ref="G00468"><he>זָכָר</he></cite>.
